card.name: Chapter and figure number punctuation
card.fires_on: Punctuation right after a chapter, figure or table number (colon, hyphen, comma), and the word Chapter in cross-references. Mostly in books, manuals and reports.

modes.label: Colon or dash after numbered heading
modes.description: Colon, hyphen or comma following Chapter, Figure or Table plus a number.
modes.example: Chapter 1<<:>> Frame Rate All videos are made up

modes.label: Chapter in cross-references
modes.description: The word Chapter or Chapters in a 'see Chapter N' reference.
modes.example: see<< Chapter>> 2, Installing and Upgrading MySQL

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated code and foreign-language pieces, so there is no clear effect beyond a few odd fragments.
card.plain: It lights up on the punctuation or word that sits between a chapter, figure or table label and what follows.
